title: Larkfield cash price list for the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Larkfield prices every item of the Urology and Continence Supply Program per billing unit. The same cash price applies on all six tiers, from the Continence Self-Pay Program to the Continence Medicaid Program. A billing unit is each catheter, drainage bag, brief, liner or underpad.

| Item | Larkfield cash price per billing unit |
|---|---|
| A4351 (straight-tip intermittent catheter) | 1.85 USD |
| A4352 (coude-tip intermittent catheter) | 3.95 USD |
| A4353 (closed-system intermittent catheter kit with insertion supplies) | 7.40 USD |
| A4349 (external catheter) | 2.65 USD |
| A4338 (indwelling catheter) | 11.90 USD |
| A4357 (drainage bag) | 6.90 USD |
| A4358 (drainage bag) | 5.75 USD |
| T4521 (brief) | 0.82 USD |
| T4522 (brief) | 0.88 USD |
| T4523 (brief) | 0.94 USD |
| T4524 (brief) | 1.06 USD |
| T4535 (liner) | 0.41 USD |
| A4554 (underpad) | 0.58 USD |


## Points of reading

- The cash price is the price per billing unit, not per box or package. **Hypothetical figure:** 30 billing units of an item priced at 1.85 USD come to 30 times 1.85 USD, which is 55.50 USD.
- The list is the same whichever payer program the coverage belongs to.
